rationale: Clean symmetric fix. Description: 'Kneel with both knees on ground, torso upright, arms at sides or on thighs for symmetrical base.' (1) Symmetric arms: leftShoulder 0→-12 (match right; slight up abduction symmetric), leftElbow 65→45 (match right). (2) neck -5→0 (no side tilt; 'lengthen up through crown' = neutral). (3) spine -5→0 (strictly upright per 'torso upright'). Legs already symmetric (leftHip=rightHip=85, leftKnee=rightKnee=100) ✓. Rig limitation: hip origin y=0.12 prevents true sitting-on-heels (knees can't reach ground); deep-knee-flexion is approximation.
